name: US law firm websites: practices, Spanish, intake, by state, county and practice area
description: US law firms, state by state and county by county, from two kinds of open source: law firms' own public websites, and official state registries published as open data for reuse (New York's attorney registrations and business entities, and the business registries of Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut, Texas and Pennsylvania). For each state, county and practice area we count the firms found, how many have a website we read, and, of those websites, the shares that show Spanish-language pages, a 24/7 intake statement, a free consultation or no fee unless they win, a chat or online booking tool, legal structured data (schema.org LegalService or Attorney), review markup or an llms.txt file, with the median number of pages a firm has about the practice. Every row compares the firms found with the employer law offices the Census Bureau's County Business Patterns counts. A state is called a census or a registry list only when that reaches 0.70; until then the rows are a sample. These counts are CC BY 4.0. The firm-level rows behind them (name as the firm or registry gives it, offices by county and the yes-or-no facts, each linked to the page it was read on with the date) are published separately under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0, because the list of sites comes partly from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors), and are shown on the /firms/ pages. No firm is rated, scored or ranked. The firm rows hold no street address, phone number or email address: a page address that contains a phone-shaped number or a street-address shape is left out, and a name that contains one is counted and not listed. Firm names can include a lawyer's name when that is the firm's registered or website name; a row that is only one person's name is counted and not listed. Website sources: Common Crawl (its web graph and the Web Data Commons structured-data extract), OpenStreetMap and Wikidata.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). US law firm websites: practices, Spanish, intake, by state, county and practice area (Version 3.2.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24148921
keywords: law firms by practice area and county
law firm free consultation and contingency

distribution.name: firm-web-census.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: firm-web-census.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: firm-rows-index.json
distribution.description: Manifest of the firm-level rows (one CSV per state, ODbL 1.0, OpenStreetMap attribution and share-alike apply). The aggregate records are CC BY 4.0.

distribution.name: firm-web-census-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in firm-web-census-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to firm-web-census.csv on id.

recordSet.name: firm-web-census
recordSet.description: The records of US law firm websites: practices, Spanish, intake, by state, county and practice area, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (50 states and DC)

field.name: level
field.description: state, state-practice or county (county x practice cells nested in practiceCells)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Law firms found (website or registry; counties and cells of 3 or more firms)

field.name: firms
field.description: Law firms found: with a website read, or from an official registry only

field.name: firms_with_website
field.description: Of those, firms whose own website we read (the base of every share)

field.name: firms_registry_only
field.description: Of those, firms found only in an official open registry (registry facts only)

field.name: coverage_label
field.description: sample below coverage_cbp 0.70; at 0.70 or more, registry list when registry rows are the majority, otherwise census

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
